name: Detect file blocks
description:
1. The user reported that the chat and chat component fail to detect file blocks.
2. Investigation showed the chat UI only recognized legacy ```` ```lang /path/file ```` fences, not the newer CODX sentinel syntax (`@@ CODX_FILE @@ … @@ CODX_END @@`).
3. The fix makes `src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js` CODX-aware by adding `getCodedFileMarker`, `parseCodedFileMetaLine`, and `readCodedFileBlock`, wired into `extractCodeBlocks` (and `hasCodeBlocksWithPaths`).
4. `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` now imports the shared `extractCodeBlocks` and delegates `extractFilesFromCodeBlocks` to it, removing its duplicate legacy-only regex.
5. Result: Files/Review actions and header file counters work for both legacy fences and CODX blocks, with streaming-safe partial rendering and no behavior change for existing blocks.

messages.content: Chat and  chat compoent fails on detecting file blocks

I'll investigate how file blocks are detected across the chat components and the markdown parser.Let me read the exact current contents of the key files to base changes on.I've traced the failure. Here's my analysis and the proposed fix. ## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core requirements** - File blocks are now emitted by the assistant using the **CODX sentinel syntax** (`@@ CODX_FILE @@ … @@ CODX_END @@`), which `src/utils/markdownParser.js` already understands (see `getCodedFileMarkers`, `parseCodedFileBlock`, `isInsideCodeFence`). - However, **file-block *detection*** used by the chat UI still only recognizes the **legacy** ```` ```lang /path/to/file ```` fences, so CODX blocks are invisible to: - **`src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js`** → `extractCodeBlocks` / `hasCodeBlocksWithPaths`. These drive `ChatEntry`'s **Files**/**Review** buttons and `MessageFileView` / `MessagePRView` (via `$service.chat.extractCodeBlocksFromMessage` and `hasCodeBlocksWithFilePaths`). - **`src/components/chat/Chat.vue`** → `extractFilesFromCodeBlocks` (feeds the header `Files: N +` list). **Strategic approach** 1. Make the shared extractor `codeBlockExtractor.js` CODX-aware while returning the **same block shape** (`{ language, filePath, content, fileName }`) so all consumers keep working unchanged. 2. Make `Chat.vue` reuse that single shared extractor instead of its own duplicate regex, so detection can never drift again. **Dependencies & risks** - No new imports cycles: `markdownParser.js` has no imports, and `codeBlockExtractor.js` will keep everything self-contained (no cross-module coupling with the Vue `$service`). - Behavior for legacy fences is preserved; only new CODX detection is added. - Streaming safe: unfinished CODX blocks yield partial content. **Target files** - `src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js` (modify) - `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` (modify) ## 2. Minimum Changes Approach 1. `src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js` — add CODX sentinel parsing (`getCodedFileMarker`, `parseCodedFileMetaLine`, `readCodedFileBlock`) and wire it into `extractCodeBlocks`. `hasCodeBlocksWithPaths` inherits it automatically. 2. `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` — import `extractCodeBlocks` and delegate `extractFilesFromCodeBlocks` to it (removes the legacy-only regex). ## 3. File changes, Code Block Formatting & Proposed Changes @@ CODX_FILE @@ path: src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js language: js change_type: update encoding: text @@ CODX_CONTENT @@ /** * Extracts code blocks with file paths from markdown content. * * Two syntaxes are supported: * * 1. Legacy fenced blocks carrying the file path on the info string: * * ```language /path/to/file * * ``` * * 2. CODX sentinel file blocks, whose body is taken verbatim (it may itself * contain fences, headings, etc.): * * @@ CODX_FILE @@ * path: * language: * change_type: * encoding: text * @@ CODX_CONTENT @@ * * @@ CODX_END @@ * * Both produce the same block shape so consumers (FileView / PRView / chat * file lists) work unchanged. */ const CODX_MARKER_REGEX = /^@{2}\s+CODX_(FILE|CONTENT|END)\s+@{2}$/ const LEGACY_FENCE_REGEX = /^```(\w+)\s+(.+)$/ /** * Detect a CODX sentinel marker on a single line. * Returns 'file' | 'content' | 'end' | null */ function getCodedFileMarker(line) { if (line?.indexOf('@') !== 0) return null const match = line.trim().match(CODX_MARKER_REGEX) if (!match) return null if (match[1] === 'FILE') return 'file' if (match[1] === 'CONTENT') return 'content' return 'end' } /** * Parse a single "key: value" metadata line found between the FILE and * CONTENT markers. */ function parseCodedFileMetaLine(line) { const match = line.match(/^\s*([A-Za-z_][\w-]*)\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*$/) if (!match) return null return { key: match[1].toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, '_'), value: match[2] } } /** * Read a full CODX file block starting at `startIndex` (the FILE marker). * * Returns { block, endIndex } where `endIndex` is the index of the last * consumed line, or null when the start marker is malformed (nested start). * Streaming friendly: a block whose CONTENT/END markers have not arrived yet * yields whatever content is available so far. */ function readCodedFileBlock(lines, startIndex) { const meta = {} let i = startIndex + 1 let contentStart = -1 let contentEnd = -1 while (i < lines.length) { const marker = getCodedFileMarker(lines[i]) if (marker === 'content') { contentStart = i + 1 break } if (marker === 'end') { // Empty body: the CONTENT marker was omitted contentStart = i contentEnd = i break } if (marker === 'file') { // Malformed: a new block opened before this one closed return null } const parsed = parseCodedFileMetaLine(lines[i]) if (parsed) meta[parsed.key] = parsed.value i++ } if (contentStart === -1) { // Metadata still streaming - no CONTENT marker yet contentStart = lines.length contentEnd = lines.length } else if (contentEnd === -1) { // Find the END marker from the content start for (let j = contentStart; j < lines.length; j++) { if (getCodedFileMarker(lines[j]) === 'end') { contentEnd = j break } } if (contentEnd === -1) contentEnd = lines.length } const filePath = meta.path || meta.file || '' const language = meta.language || 'text' return { block: { language, filePath, content: lines.slice(contentStart, contentEnd).join('\n'), fileName: filePath ? filePath.split('/').pop() : '' }, endIndex: contentEnd } } /** * Extracts code blocks with file paths from markdown content */ export function extractCodeBlocks(content) { if (!content || typeof content !== 'string') return [] const codeBlocks = [] const lines = content.split('\n') let i = 0 while (i < lines.length) { const line = lines[i] // CODX sentinel file block (verbatim body, may contain code fences) if (getCodedFileMarker(line) === 'file') { const coded = readCodedFileBlock(lines, i) if (coded) { if (coded.block.filePath) codeBlocks.push(coded.block) // Resume right after the END marker (or after the last available line) i = coded.endIndex + 1 continue } } const match = line.match(LEGACY_FENCE_REGEX) if (match) { const language = match[1] const filePath = match[2].trim() // Only include blocks with file paths if (filePath) { const blockContent = [] i++ // Collect lines until closing ``` while (i < lines.length && lines[i] !== '```') { blockContent.push(lines[i]) i++ } codeBlocks.push({ language, filePath, content: blockContent.join('\n'), fileName: filePath.split('/').pop() }) } } i++ } return codeBlocks } /** * Checks if content has extractable code blocks with file paths */ export function hasCodeBlocksWithPaths(content) { return extractCodeBlocks(content).length > 0 } @@ CODX_END @@ @@ CODX_FILE @@ path: src/components/chat/Chat.vue language: vue change_type: update encoding: text @@ CODX_CONTENT @@ @@ CODX_END @@ ## 4. File Change Summary Tables **`src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js`** | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js` | Modify | module header doc | Document both supported syntaxes (legacy fence + CODX sentinel) | | `src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js` | Modify | `getCodedFileMarker` (new) | Detect `@@ CODX_FILE/CONTENT/END @@` markers on a line | | `src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js` | Modify | `parseCodedFileMetaLine` (new) | Parse `key: value` metadata between FILE and CONTENT | | `src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js` | Modify | `readCodedFileBlock` (new) | Read a full CODX block (verbatim body, streaming-safe) → `{ language, filePath, content, fileName }` | | `src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js` | Modify | `extractCodeBlocks` | Detect and emit CODX blocks in addition to legacy fences | | `src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js` | Modify | `hasCodeBlocksWithPaths` | Inherits CODX support (drives `ChatEntry` Files/Review buttons) | **`src/components/chat/Chat.vue`** | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` | Modify | `
